name: Nakiri Sayori
source:
Hiro's classmate and student of Syouba High School. She has a firm and magnanimous personality, was pretty and had excellent grades. The entire school also chose her as their campus beauty, and the students always supported her.

[spoiler]Likes Tatsuhiko Tenjin.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]She was the class leader before Moe Miyazawa arrived. She ran in an election against Moe, but the teacher preferred Moe because she had better grades. However, Moe had no interest in being the class leader, and chose to decline this position. This humiliated and embarrassed her.[/spoiler]
